newsitem.title: UK: One lifter agrees April Souedie price - trade.
newsitem.headline: One lifter agrees April Souedie price - trade.

text.p: One contract lifter was heard to have agreed with Syria's state oil company Sytrol on a five cent rise in the price of Syria's heavy Souedie crude for April lifting, traders said on Wednesday.

The lifter was heard to have agreed to dated Brent minus $4.70 a barrel for April, up five cents from March. The other three lifters were still in negotiations with Sytrol with at least one holding off around dated Brent minus $4.95 a barrel.
Heavy crudes such as Souedie can buck the current downward price trend as the summer bitumen season approaches, traders said.
"These crudes are stronger in the summer because of the bitumen but (dated Brent) minus $4.70 is too strong," one regular lifter said.
